discovered_theme: Inbox/IMAP folders not visible in Android app after setup
root_cause_hypothesis: OAuth sign-in was never completed so IMAP folder list was never fetched, or user is viewing the Unified Inbox instead of the account.
supporting_quote: I don't have an inbox in my my email on my phone.

discovered_theme: Android app login prompt offers only 'Later', no sign-in option
root_cause_hypothesis: Imported accounts require per-account OAuth re-authorization and the sign-in button is not surfaced clearly in the notification/prompt flow.
supporting_quote: I am being prompted for a login but there is no option. My only option is "later".

discovered_theme: Self-addressed email fails to send
root_cause_hypothesis: Likely SMTP/provider loopback rejection in a non-Thunderbird client; insufficient information to confirm.
supporting_quote: Why when I try sending myself an email does it fail to send

discovered_theme: Push notifications and folder management only work for first account in multi-account Android setup
root_cause_hypothesis: Folder management UI is bound to the first/selected account and push (IMAP IDLE) is not registered per additional account, plus POP accounts lack push support.
supporting_quote: it always lets me manage folders only from the first account, and that's a major problem

discovered_theme: Only Inbox visible in Android app; other folders hidden by Unified Inbox view
root_cause_hypothesis: Unified Inbox is shown by default with multiple accounts and hides per-account folder lists, which is not discoverable.
supporting_quote: Android app. TB version 20: can only see inbox. How do I find trash, spam, and other folders

discovered_theme: Hotmail messages stuck in Outbox, cannot send
root_cause_hypothesis: Outgoing SMTP server settings or OAuth token for Outlook/Hotmail SMTP are misconfigured or unauthorized.
supporting_quote: I can receive emailsbut can not send any one. After composing , the emails stuck in the outbox

discovered_theme: Inbox/IMAP folders not visible in Android app after setup
root_cause_hypothesis: Account setup did not complete connection/OAuth so folder list never synced; folder may also be toggled hidden.
supporting_quote: can't get it to show the various Folders (Inbox, etc), nor does it upload my Email Addresses

discovered_theme: Messages appear in Unified Inbox but not in individual account folder
root_cause_hypothesis: Per-account folder display/sync setting (folder hidden or wrong special-folder mapping) for the Comcast IMAP account.
supporting_quote: the "Comcast" emails DO NOT SHOW UP IN THE "COMCAST" EMAIL FOLDER

discovered_theme: QR code account import from desktop to Android fails to scan
root_cause_hypothesis: Known QR scanning bug (issue 8520) or unsupported desktop account configuration prevents import.
supporting_quote: it's impossible to scan the QR code, it's not scanning

discovered_theme: Message list shows weekday instead of full date; setting missing in older Android version
root_cause_hypothesis: Full date/time format option was only added in version 18, so older installs lack the setting.
supporting_quote: Thunderbird does not show received email dates only the day

discovered_theme: Notification sound not played through Android Auto
root_cause_hypothesis: Thunderbird's notification channel/usage attributes are not flagged for Android Auto media/notification playback, so the sound is suppressed while projected.
supporting_quote: when I'm connected to Android Auto the notification sound doesn't play through either the phone or the car speakers

discovered_theme: QR code account import scanning fails on Xiaomi device
root_cause_hypothesis: Known camera/QR decoding bug on certain Android devices (tracked in thunderbird-android issue 8520) prevents the scan from registering.
supporting_quote: when I want to scan the QR code generated by Thunderbird on PC, nothing happens

discovered_theme: No undo for accidental swipe-to-delete on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Android app lacks an undo action stack for swipe gestures, so accidental scroll-registered swipes delete mail irreversibly from the user's view.
supporting_quote: it registers as a swipe & deletes a message. and then it's really hard to scan the trash to figure out which message it was

discovered_theme: Emails vanished after accidental archive; no trash folder visible
root_cause_hypothesis: User archived messages into Gmail's All Mail and the folder list/side panel wasn't discoverable, compounded by no .eml export support.
supporting_quote: apparently clicked something that made them all disappear... I do not have a trashcan folder

discovered_theme: QR-imported accounts show only Outbox until OAuth sign-in completed
root_cause_hypothesis: Skipping the per-account OAuth sign-in step during QR import leaves the account unauthenticated so folders are never fetched.
supporting_quote: Trying to install other email accounts, I only see the outbox, not any of the message folders.

discovered_theme: Mailing list/group email only delivered to sender
root_cause_hypothesis: Group was created in webmail or desktop; Android app has no group feature and the distribution list expansion failed at the provider.
supporting_quote: sent out an email to the members and it arrives only to me

discovered_theme: Cannot add second identity — Save button greyed out
root_cause_hypothesis: The identity editor requires a valid email address field which is not prefilled unlike desktop, leaving Save disabled without any hint.
supporting_quote: it is not allowing a 2nd identity on any of the accounts... The "Save" icon is just grayed out.

discovered_theme: Cannot create IMAP subfolders in Android app
root_cause_hypothesis: Thunderbird for Android does not implement folder creation/rename/delete, requiring webmail plus a folder list refresh.
supporting_quote: I want to create sub folders.

discovered_theme: "Edit as new mail" resets sender to default identity
root_cause_hypothesis: The edit-as-new draft composer does not read the original message's From header and falls back to the account's default identity.
supporting_quote: every time I do this, the mail's sender identity is reset to the default identity

discovered_theme: Cannot import local POP3 mail store from desktop to Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Android app only supports server-side message download; there is no local mbox/maildir import path for POP3 archives.
supporting_quote: How could I store my email folder on my phone and where to put it ?

discovered_theme: Cannot find setting to disable auto mark-as-read on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Mark as read when opened' toggle is buried under per-account reading mail settings and not surfaced by settings search.
supporting_quote: discovered it was automatically marking messages as read

discovered_theme: Unclear question about which account is configured in mail app
root_cause_hypothesis: Vague user request; would need to know what account/device issue they actually face.
supporting_quote: Wat is mijn officiële account op dit telefoon?

discovered_theme: No push notifications for new mail on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Notification settings at app/account/message level or Android OS-level channel permissions are disabled or push sync not enabled.
supporting_quote: I want a pop up notification that I don't get on GMAIL

discovered_theme: QR code account import from desktop no longer recognized after adding new account
root_cause_hypothesis: The newly added desktop account uses a protocol unsupported on Android (e.g. Exchange EWS), causing the QR import payload to be rejected.
supporting_quote: erkennt Thunderbird Mobile nun den Code nicht mehr nachdem ich ein neues Konto hinzugefügt habe

discovered_theme: Microsoft 365 autoconfig sets wrong SMTP host with no outgoing settings screen
root_cause_hypothesis: Autoconfig supplies smtp-mail.outlook.com for M365 accounts and setup blocks before the outgoing page until an admin grants OAuth IMAP/SMTP permissions in Entra.
supporting_quote: The setting should be SMTP.Office365.com but it configures it as SMTP-mail.outlook.com

discovered_theme: Address book missing after login change, recovering from profile SQLite file
root_cause_hypothesis: Thunderbird is using a new/different profile so abook.sqlite from the old profile is not loaded.
supporting_quote: Login change seems to have lost my address book.

discovered_theme: Send button missing from compose toolbar on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Known Android toolbar rendering bug (issue 10988) where theme colors make the send icon invisible or absent.
supporting_quote: The 'send' section on my email is now missing and I want it back.

discovered_theme: Empty Trash/Empty Spam does nothing in Android v21
root_cause_hypothesis: Regression introduced in Thunderbird for Android 21 broke the empty folder action; fix landed for v23.
supporting_quote: I tap on it nothing happens

discovered_theme: Android app hangs on launch
root_cause_hypothesis: App startup hang possibly from corrupted local database or sync task blocking the UI thread; needs logs/version info.
supporting_quote: I click on my thunderbird android app and it just hangs.

discovered_theme: QR code from desktop not scannable by Android camera during import
root_cause_hypothesis: Known desktop QR generation defect (issue 8520) producing codes the app's scanner cannot decode; fixed in desktop 153.
supporting_quote: All the requested QRs are generated but when I frame them with the smartphone camera they are not read

discovered_theme: Server-side IMAP search returns no results on Gmail (Android)
root_cause_hypothesis: Android app's remote search likely fails against Gmail's IMAP SEARCH semantics (X-GM-RAW/all-mail label scoping), so only locally synced recent messages match.
supporting_quote: Triggering a server side search yields nothing. If I execute the same search on Gmail I get many results.

discovered_theme: Outgoing emails permanently stuck in Outbox with no failure notification (Android)
root_cause_hypothesis: Messages exceeding the SMTP server's advertised max size are marked permanent send failures with no retry and poor user-facing notification, plus a known sync/no-network recovery bug.
supporting_quote: the outgoing emails get stuck in the OUTBOX. No amount of clicking on "Send messages" works

discovered_theme: No unread count badge on app launcher icon and no sub-15-minute fetch interval (Android)
root_cause_hypothesis: Launcher icon badge counts are unimplemented (only a widget exists) and polling intervals are floored at 15 minutes by design, requiring IMAP IDLE push instead.
supporting_quote: die Nachrichten werden nicht im Appsymbol angezeigt obwohl es überall angeschaltet ist

discovered_theme: Unsolicited vendor outsourcing suggestion for Android app quality
root_cause_hypothesis: Not a technical issue; appears to be promotional/spam content disguised as community feedback.
supporting_quote: it might be worthwhile to collaborate with experienced mobile app development companies such as AppVerticals

discovered_theme: Empty Trash/Spam does nothing in Android 21.0
root_cause_hypothesis: Known regression in the folder-purge (empty trash/spam) code path in v21, fixed in the 22.0b2 beta.
supporting_quote: said yes to the confirmation and it just sat there. No deletion.

discovered_theme: Black status bar with invisible icons on light theme when selecting a message
root_cause_hypothesis: Status bar background inverts to dark on message selection but the system bar icon/text appearance flag is not inverted, only in light theme.
supporting_quote: if I select a message, the top of the screen (where we are notifications and battery level) turns into a black bar

discovered_theme: POP3 messages disappear from Inbox after sync (Android only)
root_cause_hypothesis: The Android POP3 implementation applies server-deletion syncing/UIDL reconciliation and prunes locally stored messages that other POP clients still display.
supporting_quote: After the next synchronization, some messages disappear from the Inbox. The messages are not deleted from the server

discovered_theme: Gmail special folder assignment only offers "None" (folder list not populated)
root_cause_hypothesis: IMAP folder list was never successfully downloaded (failed sign-in/sync or POP3 account), so the special-folder pickers have no candidates.
supporting_quote: They only option Thunderbird is giving me is none

discovered_theme: Outlook.com IMAP setup fails: "User is authenticated but not connected"
root_cause_hypothesis: Microsoft-side IMAP access toggle/undocumented policy changes (and SmtpClientAuthentication disabled on new accounts) reject the connection after successful OAuth2.
supporting_quote: Authentication error. The server returned the following message: User is authenticated but not connected.

discovered_theme: Cannot move selected emails to a folder from Unified Inbox on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Move action is intentionally hidden in the unified account view (and hidden by default in visible message actions), unlike desktop.
supporting_quote: Tapping the three dot menu does not show Move option.

discovered_theme: No favorite folders feature on Android for quick move-to targets
root_cause_hypothesis: Thunderbird for Android lacks a favorites/pinning feature, only offering the 'Show in top group' folder setting.
supporting_quote: Is there a way to mark frequently used folders as favorites so they appear at the top of the folder list?

discovered_theme: Android mail notifications not dismissed after message is read
root_cause_hypothesis: Notification lifecycle isn't tied to read-state changes, and no summary/grouped notification option exists.
supporting_quote: Mail notifications remains on the home screen and need to be removed manually.

discovered_theme: Empty Trash/Empty Spam broken in Thunderbird Android 21.0
root_cause_hypothesis: Regression introduced in v21 in the empty-folder command, already fixed in 22.0b2.
supporting_quote: The "Empty Trash" and "Empty Spam" commands no longer work.

discovered_theme: Empty Trash/Empty Spam broken in Thunderbird Android 21.0
root_cause_hypothesis: Same v21 regression in the empty folder action; fixed in beta 22.0b2 pending store release.
supporting_quote: the empty trash button does not work in version 21.0. it worked perfectly in the prior versions.
